title: A Power Geometry and Hypergeometric Functions
summary: This paper is a corrected English translation of an original Japanese work introducing "power geometry," a research programme centred on power transformations, deformations and dualities of functions in the sense of optimisation theory. Its two main motivations are the origin of probability distributions (via maximum-likelihood principles, rational-function parameters and ODEs linked to information geometry, the Pearson system and Schwarzian equations) and the construction of matrix dynamical systems that compute eigenvalues, singular values and principal or minor subspaces.
